title: The hurricane that peeled the bark off trees 🌀
subject: hurricane
description:
Could a storm like this hit the Caribbean again? 👇

The Great Hurricane of 1780 tore through Barbados, Martinique and Saint Lucia in October 1780, in the middle of the American Revolution. It is still the deadliest Atlantic hurricane on record.

Sources: Wikipedia, "Great Hurricane of 1780" (citing Rodney's report, Clowes, Neely); NOAA AOML Hurricane Research Division, "235th Anniversary of the Great Hurricane of 1780" (2015); Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Great hurricane of 1780".

scenes.text: The wind peeled the bark off the trees.
Barbados, October 10, 1780. People couldn't hear their own voices over the wind.
Every house and fort fell. Admiral George Rodney reported heavy cannons carried 100 feet.
On Martinique, a 25-foot surge erased every house in Saint-Pierre. About 9,000 people died there.
At sea, the British frigate HMS Blanche vanished without a trace, in the middle of the American Revolution.
Around 22,000 people died. No Atlantic hurricane on record has killed more.
